items.title: 14.5.2 Jangal katne ka fiza par asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.5.2, printed page 311.

blocks.text: Deforestation insanon ka jaan boojh kar jangal saaf karna ya un ke darakht kam karna hai. Deforestation aalmi (global) climate ke sab se bare masail mein se ek hai. Jangal CO₂ jaisi greenhouse gases (GHGs) jazb karte hain aur hamare liye hawa saaf karte hain. Mukhtasar yeh ke deforestation ke environment par bohat se bure asraat hain, jaise biodiversity (jandaron ki qismon) ka nuqsan, climate change, mitti ki kharabi (soil degradation) aur water cycle ka bigarna.

blocks.prompt: Jangal kaatna air quality par kaise asar dalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Darakht photosynthesis se CO₂ hatate hain aur patton par dhool roktay hain. Unhen kaatne se yeh safai khatam ho jati hai, lakri mein jama carbon CO₂ ban kar nikalta hai (khaas kar jab lakri jalai jaye), aur khuli mitti se hawa dhool urati hai. Is tarah hawa zyada gandi aur greenhouse gases se bhari hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Air pollution ke insani (man-made) sources batayein.
blocks.explanation: Mobile sources: cars, trucks, hawai jahaz aur samandari engines. Point sources: factories aur bijli ghar. Yeh sab fossil fuels jala kar CO₂, CO aur hydrocarbons chhorte hain. Ghar mein lakri jalana aur bhattiyon mein coal jalana bhi.

blocks.prompt: b) PAHs zyada tar atmosphere mein kaise aate hain?
blocks.explanation: Fossil fuels (coal, oil, petrol, lakri) ke incomplete combustion se: gariyon ke dhuen, factories ke processes, khuli aag aur grill khane se. Kuch petroleum aur coal ke qudrati rasao se bhi.

blocks.prompt: c) VOCs air quality par kaise asar dalte hain?
blocks.explanation: Liquid fuels, exhaust, lakri aur koora jalne se VOCs gas ban kar hawa mein aate hain aur ghar ke andar aur bahar dono ki hawa kharab karte hain. Thori der mein aankh, naak, gale ki jalan, sar dard aur matli; lambe arse mein jigar, gurde aur nervous system ko nuqsan. Dhoop mein NOₓ ke saath mil kar yeh smog bhi banate hain.

blocks.prompt: d) Atmosphere mein heavy metals ke bare sources kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Metallurgy, battery ka koora aur incineration (koora jalana), saath factories ke processes aur transport.

items: Deforestation: CO₂ jazb karne aur hawa saaf karne wale jangal khatam; biodiversity ka nuqsan, climate change, mitti ki kharabi, water cycle ka bigarna.
